name: Bharatiya Janata Party
origin: Formed after leaders of the former Jana Sangh left the Janata Party. Atal Bihari Vajpayee became its founding president.

name: Indian National Congress
origin: The first Congress session brought 72 delegates together in Bombay, now Mumbai. Its organisation and political role developed through subsequent historical periods.

name: All India Trinamool Congress
origin: Mamata Banerjee established Trinamool Congress following her departure from the Indian National Congress.

name: Aam Aadmi Party
origin: The party emerged from the India Against Corruption movement. Its archived account records 26 November 2012 as its inception date.

name: Bahujan Samaj Party
origin: Founded by Kanshi Ram. The Library of Congress archive documents its formation year and preserves an archived party website.

name: Communist Party of India
origin: The party's own historical account dates its formation to a conference in Kanpur. Accounts of the earlier communist movement use different milestones.

name: Communist Party of India (Marxist)
origin: Formed following the division in the Communist Party of India. The two organisations retain separate party identities and election records.

name: Samajwadi Party
origin: Founded by Mulayam Singh Yadav. The party's published history records its establishment in 1992.

name: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
origin: Formed in Madras, now Chennai, by a group led by C. N. Annadurai following a division in Dravidar Kazhagam.

name: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
origin: Established by M. G. Ramachandran. Its history is presented separately from DMK election results.

name: Telugu Desam Party
origin: N. T. Rama Rao announced the Telugu Desam Party in Hyderabad in 1982.

name: Yuvajana Sramika Rythu Congress Party
origin: The party's milestone account records the inauguration of its flag on 12 March 2011. This is a public-launch milestone, not a claim about its legal registration date.

name: Janata Dal (United)
origin: The party's account dates its present organisation to 30 October 2003. Earlier Janata Dal-related organisations are not automatically merged into this record.

name: Rashtriya Janata Dal
origin: The party's published introduction records its establishment in 1997.

name: Jharkhand Mukti Morcha
origin: Formation details need further source reconciliation. This profile keeps its election records available without publishing a disputed foundation date.

name: Shiv Sena
origin: Balasaheb Thackeray founded the original Shiv Sena in 1966. Records under the SHS and SHSUBT codes remain separate; this date describes the original organisation, not every later faction.

name: Shiv Sena (Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray)
origin: ECI's dispute records include its October 2022 letters on the Shiv Sena name and symbols. This electoral identity is kept separate from SHS and is not treated as a new founding of the original 1966 movement.

name: Nationalist Congress Party
origin: ECI's published landmark judgments record the original organisation's May 1999 committee resolution and June 1999 convention. NCP and NCPSP results remain separate after the later split.

name: Nationalist Congress Party – Sharadchandra Pawar
origin: This profile preserves NCPSP-coded election records separately from NCP. A sourced formation and recognition timeline has not yet been added.

name: Indian Union Muslim League
origin: Its published historical account records its formation in Madras, now Chennai, in March 1948.
